name: stagewise
long_description: stagewise is building the open-source agentic IDE: a developer workspace for creating and orchestrating coding agents, previewing running apps, and managing Git workflows. Developers can run agents in parallel, use their preferred models or existing coding subscriptions, and keep agents connected to browser/runtime context as well as the broader codebase, from APIs and tests to docs and deployment paths.

launches.title: stagewise: The frontend coding agent for production codebases
launches.tagline: Visually build your apps frontend right inside your browser on localhost.
launches.body:
# **TL;DR**

**stagewise is a frontend coding agent for production codebases**

→ ❌ No more tedious context switching\
→ 🤝 Works with all kinds of web app frameworks\
→ 🚀 Integrates into existing, production-grade apps

Get started now on [stagewise.io](https://stagewise.io#quickstart) and use the code **STAGELAUNCH** to **get 25% off for 3 months**! 🎉

‎

# **WATCH THE DEMO**

https://youtu.be/q7JFZBEfyjo

---

---

# **ABOUT US**

We’re **Julian** and **Glenn**, and we’ve built **stagewise** because we wanted to quickly iterate on app frontends with AI - even if they’re not just simple prototypes anymore, but real projects.

‎

# **THE PROBLEM**

**AI-powered app builders work great - until they don’t.**

Once you move into a production-grade project setup on your local machine, you lose the awesome experience of visually building your apps frontend with simple prompts.

You move from tools like **v0 or Lovable** to tools like **Cursor and Claude Code**, but there’s a catch.

**AI code editors are** **not good at building frontends**, because:\
→ They don’t understand your apps user experience\
→ They don’t see your browser content, but only the codebase\
→ You have to switch between browser and IDE all the time

‎

# **THE SOLUTION**

With stagewise, we’ve developed an **open-source** and **framework-independent** toolbar that brings our frontend coding agent **right into your web app on localhost**.\
\
Here’s how it works:\
→ You prompt changes by clicking and commenting on elements in your app\
→ We automatically collect browser and app metadata\
→ The agent makes precise changes to your local codebase

The toolbar has already surpassed **4,800 GitHub-stars** ⭐️ and **130,000 downloads 📈**

‎

# **OUR VISION**

_We believe that the best user experiences are built by **iterating fast** and putting yourselves **in the shoes of your user**._

_Our product enables teams to do exactly that - and we continue to work on a future, where awesome production-grade user experiences can be built lightning-fast and without coding skills._

‎
